revisionNote: Pre-release revision 5 (2026-09-27). Appended Gravity X/Y/Z (17-19), Linear Drag (20), Color Start (21), Color End (22), Size End (23) and Opacity End (24) so the emitter -> force -> appearance -> output chain is authorable from the effect controls as well as from the dockable panel. Defaults reproduce the previous look (no gravity, no drag, white, constant size/opacity). Prior revision 4 appended AE arbitrary graph data (14), Control Source (15) and Capture Current Controls (16) for ADR 0008; revision 3 added Emitter Size and Velocity Spread; revision 2 split Velocity into scalar sliders and added 3D Emitter Origin. Released IDs are never renumbered. Capture samples current time into a graph and does not convert legacy keyframe tracks.

parameters.label: Emitter Origin
parameters.note: AE position control with comp-view picking. The registered 50/50/50 default uses AE's centre convention; checked-out values are normalized by the adapter to layer-centred world units. A compatibility shim remains until the current 13-control build is read back in AE 2023.

parameters.label: Velocity Y
parameters.note: Positive moves up. The 0.3 default keeps a freshly applied instance visibly alive instead of showing one static dot.

parameters.label: Velocity Z
parameters.note: Positive moves toward the viewer. Reserved for depth; the 2D compositor ignores it.

parameters.label: Particle Size
parameters.note: Sprite diameter in full-resolution layer pixels.

parameters.label: Emitter Size
parameters.note: Cube edge length for Box, diameter for Sphere and Disc. Ignored by the Point emitter.

parameters.label: Velocity Spread
parameters.note: Independent uniform jitter applied to each particle's velocity per axis. Without it every particle behaves identically and a steady emitter looks frozen, because births keep replacing the particles that leave; this is also what makes Random Seed visible.

parameters.label: Node Graph Data
parameters.note: Canonical schema-1 graph bytes; AE owns copy, persistence and undo. The default and every capture contain the single-emitter emitter -> force -> appearance -> output chain (ADR 0008).

parameters.label: Control Source
parameters.note: USE_VALUE_FOR_OLD_PROJECTS preserves existing animated controls; switching alone never replaces the graph.

parameters.label: Capture Current Controls
parameters.note: Explicitly replaces stored graph with current control values and selects Node Graph in one undoable transaction. Does not convert animation tracks.

parameters.label: Gravity X
parameters.note: Force-node input. Positive moves right. Zero keeps the M2 straight-line trajectory.

parameters.label: Gravity Y
parameters.note: Force-node input. Negative pulls particles down.

parameters.label: Gravity Z
parameters.note: Force-node input. Reserved for depth; the 2D compositor ignores Z.

parameters.label: Linear Drag
parameters.note: Force-node input. Integrated in closed form as dv/dt = gravity - drag*v, so frame order and subframes stay exact.

parameters.label: Color Start
parameters.note: Appearance-node birth color. 8-bit channels are mapped to working-space 0..1 with no color-space conversion (ADR 0005); alpha comes from Opacity.

parameters.label: Color End
parameters.note: Appearance-node color reached as particle age approaches lifetime. Equal to Color Start by default.

parameters.label: Size End
parameters.note: Appearance-node size reached as age approaches lifetime; Particle Size is the birth value. Equal by default.

parameters.label: Opacity End
parameters.note: Appearance-node opacity reached as age approaches lifetime; Opacity is the birth value. Equal by default.

compatibility.idPolicy: Released numeric IDs are permanent; never renumber or reuse. IDs are still being shaped until the first shared release.
compatibility.migrationPolicy: Add IDs for new controls. Removed controls become hidden compatibility parameters when old project data needs them.
compatibility.controlSupervision: All bound controls (1-13 and 17-24) are registered supervised. While Control Source is Node Graph, an edit to any bound control rewrites the canonical arbitrary graph from the delivered values in the same undoable user-change transaction (ADR 0009); in AE Controls mode the stored graph is never touched.
